USER GUIDE

Using the TrackVision app

Day-to-day use of the TrackVision Factory Activation app on the line: activating garments, fixing mistakes and getting help. The tablet must already be set up with the factory setup guide.

Contents

  1. The main screen
  2. Choose a purchase order
  3. Activate garments
  4. What the screens mean
  5. Working without WiFi
  6. Deactivate a code
  7. Check a code's status
  8. Get help
  9. The scanner
  10. Settings
1

The main screen

The app opens on the list of purchase orders. The black bar at the top is on every screen.

  • Left: the menu button and your factory's name.
  • A red Scanner disconnected label means the tablet cannot see the scanner. See section 9, The scanner.
  • The bell shows replies from TrackVision. A number means something new: tap the bell to read it.
  • Right: the app version, the battery and the connection. Green Online is good; red Offline means no WiFi.

Tap the menu button (three lines) to move between screens.

2

Choose a purchase order

Each card is one purchase order (PO): its number, where it ships, its date and how many items are activated.

  • The large percentage and the count below it show progress. Confirmed activated is the server's count. Estimated activated includes this tablet's scans that are not confirmed yet. Loading count… means the count is on its way.
  • The bar is green while there is more to do, yellow at exactly 100% and red above 100% (more activated than ordered).
  • Tap the arrow on the right to see each product on the order with its own count.
  • To find an order, tap the search box and type part of the PO number on the keypad.
  • Tap an order to open it and start activating.

Closed and cancelled orders

Closed and cancelled orders are hidden. To see them, tap Closed and cancelled, then See orders. A yellow bar shows you are looking at them; tap Back to open to return.

3

Activate garments

Open the order. Each garment needs two scans: its hang tag and its garment label. Scan them in either order.

  • The green chip next to the PO number shows what the hang tag carries: SGTIN is a QR code, EAN is a barcode.
  • After the first scan its box turns blue-green with a tick and the product details.
  • Scan the second label. A green screen with Activation saved means the garment is done. Scan the next garment straight away.
  • Scanned the wrong first label? Tap Reset and start that garment again.
  • Use the arrow at the top left to go back to the order list.

The bar at the bottom shows what the tablet is waiting for, and how many scans are saved on the tablet and not sent yet.

4

What the screens mean

Green: done. The garment is activated.
Yellow: check this. Either the item was activated before, or it was saved on the tablet without WiFi. Read the message; it closes by itself, or tap Dismiss to scan again.
Red: not saved. Read the message, put the garment aside if needed, then tap Dismiss to scan again. Red screens stay until you tap.
Blue: a deactivation went through.

A short red flash with a low beep and no message means the code is the wrong type for this order (for example a barcode on an SGTIN order). It is ignored: scan the right label.

A red message you do not understand, or one that keeps coming back? Open the menu, choose Need Help? and tell TrackVision.
5

Working without WiFi

You can keep activating when the WiFi drops. Each garment is saved on the tablet (yellow Activation Queued (Offline)) and sent automatically when the WiFi is back.

  • A yellow bar shows how many activations are saved on the tablet. It turns red when the tablet is nearly full.
  • At the limit (usually 150) scanning stops until the WiFi is back. Move closer to the WiFi or ask for help.
  • The order list shows how many scans from this tablet are waiting to upload.
  • Deactivation and Status Check need WiFi.
Never reset the tablet while scans are waiting to upload: they would be lost.
6

Deactivate a code

To undo an activation (for example a garment that is rejected), open the menu and choose Deactivate Code. Scan the garment label (or an SGTIN hang tag QR).

  • A blue screen with Deactivation accepted means it is done.
  • Deactivation needs WiFi. Without it the screen says Connect to the internet to deactivate.
  • If it is refused, a red message explains why, with a button to ask for help.
7

Check a code's status

To see whether a garment is active, open the menu and choose Status Check, then scan its garment label or hang tag QR. The tablet shows the product, the order, whether it is ACTIVE or INACTIVE, and its history. This needs WiFi.

8

Get help

Open the menu and choose Need Help?. Pick the problem, type a short note about what happened and tap Send request. TrackVision gets it with this tablet's details.

  • Without WiFi the request is saved and sent automatically later.
  • Replies appear under Previous tickets. The bell at the top shows when there is a new one.
  • TrackVision may also send messages, for example asking you to update the app. They appear in the same place.
9

The scanner

If the red Scanner disconnected label appears, unplug the scanner and plug it in again. The label disappears as soon as the tablet sees it.

  • Make sure the scanner has power. Some tablets cannot power a scanner on their own.
  • The scanner must type in US / English. If scans come out wrong, the scanner may need resetting.
  • New or replaced scanner: open Settings, tap New Scanner and follow the three steps to test it. Nothing is recorded during the test.
10

Settings

Open the menu and choose Settings.

  • Language: the app's language. It changes at once.
  • Factory Time Zone: change it only if it is wrong for this factory.
  • Tap Save to keep a change.
Reset Tablet erases this tablet's setup. Only use it when TrackVision or your supervisor asks, and never while scans are waiting to upload.
